edits.why: Tokens come from maude-v2. The v2 component sheet loads last, so the shared controls take the v2 look. The old sheet stays only as a bridge for .panel, .tree-row, .callout and .btn--danger, which v2 doesn't have.
The canvas header names its design system. It should match the meta.

notes: Every var(--…) token in this canvas also exists in maude-v2, so no token is renamed.

Classes that v2 doesn't have, used here: .panel (lines 109, 174, 195, 241), .tree-row (134–138), .btn--danger (249), .callout with --warn/--error/--success/--info (262–294). The edge-states artboard is built on .callout, so it depends on the bridge.
The theme stays forced to dark (line 309).
The device code uses mono. That fits maude-v2, which keeps mono for Advanced and code.
Not in this switch: the IdentityBar is docked in a full-height sidebar. That breaks maude-v2's 'Chrome floats; it never frames.' Fixing it is a redesign.
The prose in the header comment (lines 11–16) and the comment in the sibling GitHubIdentity.css still name the maude DS. Both are text only.
